fields.statement: Change set 01M77N1 (Fix watchdog unmerged PR at land): ship-change's land step was refused because another accepted change set (auto-update) had landed a new statement for the same node first. land-triage only passes gate failures, so the run ended and the orchestrator repaired it by hand with `rhiza set --rebase` (commit 480b6acf3). How should ship-change handle a land refused for a model conflict?
